legal_basis: Agreement on cooperation and customs union between the EEC and San Marino (OJ L 84, 28.3.2002), art. 2-3
note: San Marino applies the EU Common Customs Tariff and the EU preferential arrangements on goods other than the ECSC products (chapters 72, 73 and coal). Those are left out of the weight, as before.

legal_basis: Agreement in the form of an exchange of letters between the EEC and Andorra (OJ L 374, 31.12.1990), art. 3 and 6
note: Andorra applies the EU Common Customs Tariff on chapters 25 to 97. Chapters 1 to 24 are outside the customs union and Andorra has no TRAINS schedule for them, so they stay out of the weight.
